capabilities: refine reading layout, heading scale, and typography in Reading view and Live Preview
clean emphasis spans and citation-button residue from rich text pasted from web pages and ChatGPT
convert recognized bordered web content into native Obsidian callouts
align standalone images and resize Markdown table columns by dragging, double-clicking, or arrow keys
lock relative scrolling between two side-by-side notes from chosen positions
disambiguation: Not a Notion or ChatGPT integration; the name refers to restrained reading styles and cleanup of pasted ChatGPT rich text.
extras: Desktop only (no mobile) and requires Obsidian 1.14.0 or later. An optional Windows PowerShell installer backs up and disables superseded local extensions and CSS snippets. No telemetry, accounts, or network requests. The README lists known limitations and incomplete desktop-interaction verification.
intentEvidence: This is the unified successor to the local 49-notion-gpt package
problem: Obsidian's default reading layout, rich-text paste handling, fixed table column widths, and independent pane scrolling give users little control when reading or importing web content.

relations.evidence: the unified successor to the local 49-notion-gpt package, the compact-rich-paste, relative-scroll-lock, and native-table-resize extensions
The relative-scroll module incorporates the author's earlier Relative Scroll Lock project
The optional browser helper copies from rendered ChatGPT content

requires.name: browser helper for copying rendered ChatGPT content

summary: Desktop plugin bundle that refines Reading view styling, cleans rich-text pastes, aligns images, resizes Markdown table columns, and locks two-pane scrolling.
